confirmed_task:
On the official Python image’s Docker Hub Tags page, search for 3.12-slim. Among results whose tag names begin exactly with 3.12-slim, report the three most recently updated tag names, their displayed update dates or times, and their displayed Linux/amd64 image sizes.

Stopping condition: Stop after three exact-prefix matching tags and all requested displayed fields have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not pull or run an image.
- Exclude substring matches that do not begin with 3.12-slim, and do not substitute sizes from another operating system or architecture.
- If Linux/amd64 size is not displayed for a matching tag, report it as unavailable rather than guessing.

items.criterion: Use the official Python image Docker Hub Tags page and search for 3.12-slim
items.description: Attempt to use the official Python image Docker Hub Tags page (e.g., https://hub.docker.com/_/python/tags) and use the page’s search/filter for the query '3.12-slim' without signing in. Full credit if the agent clearly attempts this and either successfully searches or documents an uncontrollable blocker (CAPTCHA, login wall, heavy script failure, rate limiting, site down) that prevents searching. Partial credit if the agent uses a materially different query or uses an alternative source without first attempting the official tags page (unless the tags page is demonstrably blocked).

items.criterion: Identify up to three most recently updated tags whose names begin exactly with 3.12-slim
items.description: From the visible search results, select tags whose names start with the exact prefix '3.12-slim' (exclude non-prefix substring matches). Rank by the 'most recently updated' value as displayed. Full credit if the agent reports exactly three such tags when at least three are visible/accessible, and they are the most recently updated among the visible exact-prefix matches. If fewer than three exact-prefix matches are visible/accessible due to uncontrollable UI limitations (e.g., results not loading, infinite scroll not functioning, pagination blocked), award full credit for reporting as many as can be reliably captured and explicitly stating why three could not be obtained. Partial credit if three are reported but ordering is incorrect while still being exact-prefix matches.

items.criterion: Report displayed update date/time for each selected tag (or state unavailable)
items.description: For each of the reported exact-prefix matching tags, report the update date/time exactly as displayed on the Docker Hub Tags page (e.g., '2025-01-10' or '2 days ago'). Full credit if update info is provided for all reported tags, or if the agent explicitly reports 'unavailable' when the UI does not display an update value for a tag or the value is not accessible due to an uncontrollable limitation. Partial credit if update info is missing for one reported tag without explanation or is paraphrased such that the displayed value is lost.

items.criterion: Report displayed Linux/amd64 image size for each selected tag (or 'unavailable')
items.description: For each reported tag, report the Linux/amd64 image size as displayed on the Docker Hub Tags page, without substituting sizes from other OS/architectures and without guessing. Full credit if Linux/amd64 sizes are correctly provided for all reported tags, or if the agent explicitly reports 'unavailable' when Linux/amd64 size is not displayed/accessible in the UI for a tag (including cases where only a generic size is shown with no arch/OS breakdown). Partial credit if one tag’s Linux/amd64 size is missing without explanation while others are correct.

items.criterion: Respect stated constraints (no sign-in; no pull/run; exclude non-prefix matches; stop after three)
items.description: The agent must not sign in, must not pull or run any images, must exclude tags that do not begin exactly with '3.12-slim', and must stop after collecting three exact-prefix matching tags and all requested fields (or stop earlier only if fewer than three are accessible and this is clearly explained). Full credit if all constraints are followed. No credit if the agent signs in, pulls/runs an image, includes any non-prefix match in the reported set, or reports more than three tags after being able to capture three.
